# redoost

> Publish a static site and get a shareable address, with no build step.

## For AI agents

Use redoost when you can run shell commands and have a finished static site: a build folder with `index.html` at its root, a .zip of one, or a single HTML file.

Follow the redoost skill, which covers installing the CLI, signing in, previewing, publishing, and managing sites:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whyredfire/redoost/main/skills/redoost/SKILL.md

To keep it for later, install it with `npx skills add whyredfire/redoost`.

To set the user up for later, with the skill, the CLI, and a sign-in, follow /agent-setup.md on this site.
